tail:
Batch 29 is now complete. Summary of this session's work (building on the existing authored items):

## What was missing and is now done

**1. Page carriers (critical gap).** The two markdown page carriers for the pair did not exist on disk (`library/non-relativistic-classical-mechanics/cm13-…md` and `…-examples.md`) — only the manifest was present, and `dispatch-author-artifacts.mjs` requires both page files. Both were authored with plan-matching frontmatter (`items`/`examples`/`requires`) and page prose covering all 15 A-page items and 6 worked checks.

**2. Cross-batch dependency inputs.** Authored `…batch-29.cross-batch-dependencies.json`: 178 rows (176 item edges + 2 page `requires` edges) with consumer-side evidence, covering supplier batches 6, 10, 17, 18, 19, 23, 28 (28 distinct suppliers). `frontier-dependency-ledger.mjs refresh` accepted it: 178/178 reviewed, 0 orphaned, 0 without review.

**3. Stale proof contract repaired.** `proof-contract --strict` initially reported 37 `citation-quote-mismatch` errors because late item edits (removing same-page forward links) postdated the last regeneration. All 15 entries were regenerated → **0 errors, 0 warnings**. One citation-fidelity widening candidate (F1 of `pthm-cm13-observable-evolution`) was human-read and dismissed as a detector false positive (matched "any solution" case-insensitively), recorded via the tool's `reviewed.upheld` mechanism with reasons.

**4. Stale manifest statements re-synced.** Seven manifest `statement` fields carried pre-edit texts; all re-synced from the carriers. Verified manifest ≡ item carriers across title, kind, domain, statement, strategy, deps, roles, level, provenance, physical_scope, sources (ASCII-escaped convention preserved).

**5. Design-pointer reconciliation recorded.** The reservation cites "T§§4.2,4.4,4.6; S Ch5; L§10.4"; Tong §4.6 (adiabatic invariants) and Likharev §10.4 (Hamilton–Jacobi) are cm14 subject matter (provisional items `cm14-adiabatic-invariant`, `cm14-hj`). Four explicit `deferred` coverage rows were added with destination `cm14-hamilton-jacobi-and-integrability` and reasons; flagged for the owner in the notes as a reservation-split artifact (cm14's own list cites T§§4.5,4.7 / L§§10.5–10.6).

**6. Notes and readiness.** Wrote `…batch-29.notes.md` (inventory with levels, design-vs-plan, sources/coverage, cross-batch, repairs, checks, run-level findings, choice assumptions). Recorded all 21 `step1-decisions` `ready` records after the final carriers; `check --run` shows **0 stale cm13 records**.
